links.comparator_used: Published PREVENT equations used as-is, compared with locally fitted Cox, discrete-time neural network, and recalibrated PREVENT models
links.outcome: Discrimination (C-index) and calibration (expected vs observed 5-year CVD event rates)
links.effect: Local adaptation minimally affected discrimination and modestly improved calibration. The abstract gives no numeric effect for the adapted models.
links.quote: Local adaptations minimally affected discrimination and modestly improved calibration.

design_hint: local recalibration/retraining of risk model before deployment
